facets.description: `true` to also answer `facets`: every mode, vehicle, map and result this account's battles have, counted over all of them regardless of the filters above. Left out by default, since only a page that draws filters needs it.

limit.description: Battles per page, newest first. Ten by default, a hundred at most.

map.description: Only battles on this arena, by the game's own map id (`05_prohorovka`). `facets.maps` lists the ones it has.

mode.description: Only battles of this mode, by the game's own `bonusType` (1 is random battles). `facets.modes` lists the ones this account has.

page.description: Which page of `limit` battles, newest first, counted from one. The first by default; `total` in the answer says how many there are.

result.description: Only battles this account won, lost or drew.

tank.description: Only battles this account fought in this vehicle, by its tank id. `facets.tanks` lists the ones it has.
